value.rationale: Quantifies with an exact algebraic phase transition when social influence connectivity becomes permanently disconnected even as every opinion converges to consensus. The initial five-node tree is sharp within a natural single missing-bridge regime, and the first-reception delay diverges at an explicit inverse spectral-gap scale. This replaces qualitative simulation-only possibility with a rigorous small-structure boundary; the codimension-one initial condition and restricted scope are acknowledged.
